stem.text: A student used a diagram to show four types of cells involved in the primary immune response.

stem.alt: Flow diagram: an oval labelled unknown antigen enters the body, with arrows pointing to four boxes labelled cell type 1, cell type 2, cell type 3 and cell type 4.

A.text: B-lymphocyte; macrophage; T-killer cell; T-helper cell

B.text: macrophage; B-lymphocyte; T-helper cell; T-killer cell

C.text: T-helper cell; T-killer cell; B-lymphocyte; macrophage

D.text: T-killer cell; T-helper cell; B-lymphocyte; macrophage
